title: Helios Console — Branding & UX
description: Branding and user-experience settings for Helios Console. Preference domain: com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.ui — deploy as its own Jamf Pro Application & Custom Settings profile, scoped to all Macs running Helios (no secrets, safe to scope broadly). The override lists here are cosmetic only — all gating is role-based in the access domain. Values take effect at app relaunch.

configurationVersion.title: Configuration Version
configurationVersion.description: Schema/profile version stamp (informational — the loader logs it, nothing else reads it).

userInterface.title: User Interface
userInterface.description: Branding and top-level UI visibility switches.

appTitle.title: App Title
appTitle.description: Primary app title shown in branding surfaces.

appSubtitle.title: App Subtitle
appSubtitle.description: Secondary title shown under the app title.

supportURL.title: Support URL
supportURL.description: Help/support link surfaced in the app (e.g. on the login screen). Leave empty to hide. e.g. https://support.yourcompany.com

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Organization name used in branding surfaces. Leave empty for none.

logoURL.title: Logo URL
logoURL.description: HTTPS URL to a custom organization logo image. Leave empty to use the built-in branding.

accentColor.title: Accent Color (hex)
accentColor.description: Accent color as a 6-digit hex value, e.g. #007AFF.

defaultColorScheme.title: Default Color Scheme
defaultColorScheme.description: Preferred appearance for the app. 'system' follows the macOS appearance.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: Marketing tagline under the wordmark on the welcome screen. Empty = built-in copy.

footerText.title: Footer Text
footerText.description: Footer/copyright line on the Settings About card. Empty = composed from the product name and current year.

documentationURL.title: Documentation URL
documentationURL.description: Destination for the About card's Documentation link and the welcome screen's Learn More button. Empty = those affordances are hidden.

feedbackURL.title: Feedback URL
feedbackURL.description: Destination for the About card's Report an Issue link. Empty = the row is hidden.

sidebarItems.title: Sidebar Item Overrides (optional)
sidebarItems.description: Optional label/icon overrides for sidebar rows — cosmetic only. Row presence and order come from the access domain's role modules. Blank field = built-in value; unknown ids are skipped. (`title` is accepted as an alias for `displayName`.)

id.title: Row ID
id.description: Which sidebar row this override applies to. Pick a known route id.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Label to show for this row. Blank = the app's built-in label.

icon.title: Icon (SF Symbol)
icon.description: Free-form SF Symbol name for this row (e.g. gearshape). Blank = the app's built-in icon.

deviceTabs.title: Devices-Tab Label Overrides (optional)
deviceTabs.description: Optional label renames for tabs inside the Devices module — cosmetic only, no icon override. Tab presence comes from the access domain's role deviceTabs. An id absent here keeps its built-in title.

id.title: Tab ID
id.description: Which Devices tab this rename applies to.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Label to show for this tab. Blank = the tab's built-in title.

deviceActionLabels.title: Device-Action Label Overrides (optional)
deviceActionLabels.description: Optional label/icon overrides for the device Actions menu — cosmetic only. Action availability is gated by the access domain roles; this list never makes an action appear. Blank field = built-in. Confirmation-dialog safety copy is never overridable.

id.title: Action ID
id.description: Which device action this override applies to.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Menu label to show for this action. Blank = the action's built-in label.

icon.title: Icon (SF Symbol)
icon.description: Free-form SF Symbol name for this action (e.g. bolt.fill). Blank = the action's built-in icon.
